title: Air conditioner control experiment (10 subjects, 4 classes, 25 EEG ch)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 10 healthy subjects performing a P300-based brain-computer interface task for home appliance control. The experiment employed a visual oddball paradigm with 25-channel EEG acquisition at 500 Hz, featuring target and non-target stimulus classifications. The dataset includes 50 training and 30 testing trials per subject, with visual feedback provided during online BCI operation.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 25-channel actiCHamp system (Brain Products) at 500 Hz sampling rate with linked mastoid reference. Electrodes were positioned according to the standard 10-20 montage (Fp1, Fpz, Fp2, F7, F3, Fz, F4, F8, FC5, FC1, FC2, FC6, C3, Cz, C4, CP5, CP1, CP2, CP6, P3, Pz, P4, O1, Oz, O2). The paradigm employed a visual oddball design with 750 ms stimulus onset asynchrony and 1 s trial duration, with visual feedback presented on an LCD display.
